_comment: Claude Code hook configuration. Hook commands use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so they resolve from the project root regardless of the working directory when the hook runs (handlers run in the CURRENT dir, not root — see Claude Code hooks docs). This prevents the gate from failing-closed and blocking all tools when cwd drifts.
_extension_guide: Add domain-specific hooks by appending to the arrays below. Base hooks stay untouched.

PreToolUse.description: Permission gate: deny-list + phase-gate + egress. Exits 2 to BLOCK.
Blocks hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords in code).

PostToolUse.description: Records every tool execution result to audit.log.

Stop.description: Records session end to the audit log.
Warns if progress.md was not updated this session.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,time; p=os.path.join(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR','.'),'Harness-Best-Practice/progress.md'); mtime=os.path.getmtime(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 0; print('WARNING: progress.md not updated this session') if (time.time()-mtime) > 3600 else None"
